summary: This note is a short encyclopedia-style entry about A Don, a village in south-eastern Laos. It states that the village lies near the Vietnamese border and belongs to Kaleum District in Sekong Province.
one_line: A Don is a village in south-eastern Laos near the Vietnam border, located in Kaleum District, Sekong Province.
